answer.answer: No studies in this dataset have sampling dates confined to 2000-2004 (nearby studies span decades, e.g., 1972-2010 or 2001-2012), so a valid median for that window cannot be computed. Even if it could, comparing a handful of studies across different regions, mesh sizes, and methods over 20 years would not demonstrate an actual ocean-wide trend due to confounding sampling differences.
